Directions: Based on the following passage, answer each question that follows.
Content: “'I cannot make a tree grow or flourish' [said the gardener]... 'All I do is avoid hindering a tree's growth-I have no power to make it grow.'
'Would it be possible to apply this philosophy of yours to the art of government?' asked the questioner.
'My only art is the growing of trees,' said [the gardener]. 'Government is not my business.'”
